subject: AcmeCloud Azure listing: account prerequisites and technical sprint plan
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acmecloud.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2027-01-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick intro — Azure listing: what we need from Acme to start

Hi Tessa / Naomi,

Thanks for the intro — I'm Sarah, head of partnerships at AcmeCloud. We're ready to begin the Azure Marketplace listing and want to coordinate publisher account setup and the technical validation gate. High-level: this is a SaaS multi-tenant control plane with a single-tenant subscription model for customers.

Can you send an initial checklist of the account/identity proofs and the technical artifacts (manifest, sample provisioning flow, endpoint verification) that the Azure validation team expects? We'd like to set up a short 3-day internal sprint to gather everything.

Attached is a one-pager on AcmeCloud's product and a diagram of our tenant isolation model (acme_product_brief.pdf).

Questions from our side:
- Do we need a managed service principal in the publisher tenant vs. a service principal per offer?
- Is the co-sell registration separate from the publisher enrollment?

Open to a quick 30-min sync next week. Proposed time: Tue 1/11 or Wed 1/12 PST.

Best,
Sarah Lin
Head of Partnerships, AcmeCloud
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

(attachment: acme_product_brief.pdf)

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acmecloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2027-01-06T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro — Azure listing: what we need from Acme to start

Hi Sarah — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the brief — helpful. I'm copying Marissa and Karthik who run publisher ops and the technical gating.

High-level checklist to get your publisher account and offer into the Azure pipeline:
1) Publisher enrollment: tenant contact, legal entity name, DUNS/Tax ID, verified support email (we can share the enrollment URL)
2) Identity proof: screenshot of the publisher tenant, subscription ID for a test subscription, and proof of owner (tenant-proof.pdf later)
3) Technical artifacts: offer manifest (sample_manifest.json), ARM templates or provisioning runbook, a smoke-test endpoint we can hit from Azure datacenter (region details), and OAuth/service principal details
4) Security/compliance: SOC2 or equivalent evidence if you plan to enable co-sell (helps with commercial eligibility)

For service principal: you can either provide a publisher-level managed identity (preferred) or create a delegated SP for the specific offer. We'll document the minimal permissions required — usually the SP needs read/list on the test subscription and the ability to validate callback URLs.

I've attached a short publisher checklist that we'll use during the sprint (publisher_checklist.xlsx). Can you confirm who on your infra team will provide the subscription and whether read-only access works for validation?

Proposed sprint approach (3 working days):
- Day 0: kickoff + collect legal/tenant proofs + grant test subscription read access
- Day 1: upload manifest + run smoke tests from Azure validation nodes
- Day 2: address any manifest/ARM issues and finalize submission to the portal.

If that works, let's lock Tue 1/11 10:00 AM PST for a 30-min kickoff.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
(attachment: publisher_checklist.xlsx)

From: Azure Marketplace Ops <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acmecloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-01-07T15:45:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Quick intro — Azure listing: what we need from Acme to start

Hi Sarah / Tessa / Marissa,

Thanks for the context. A few clarifications from the Marketplace validation team so we can pre-scope the technical gate: 
- We require a publisher-enrolled tenant with a verified Microsoft seller account. If you haven't enrolled, complete the enrollment form here: https://portal.azure.com/publisher-enrollment
- For offer manifest validation we need: sample_manifest.json, deployment template (ARM/Bicep), a staging endpoint (reachable from public internet or via provided tunnel), and a small smoke-test script (curl commands) we can run from validation agents.
- Identity: the SP should be created in the publisher tenant with the following minimum roles: Reader on the subscription + Contributor on the resource group used for provisioning tests. If you cannot grant Contributor, provide an SAS-provisioned resource we can use.
- Co-sell: registration is a separate workflow post-publish. You can submit for commercial marketplace review once the offer is live; we'll flag co-sell eligibility during the offer review if all commercial docs are present.

Attached is a sanitized sample_manifest.json and our validation checklist (sample_manifest.json). Also, please provide the tenant verification doc (tenant-proof.pdf) and a link to any SOC2/reporting if applicable.

If it's helpful, we can fast-track a validation window the week of Jan 18 if your sprint completes prior.

Regards,
Azure Marketplace Validation Team
(attachment: sample_manifest.json)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acmecloud.com>, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2027-01-10T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AcmeCloud Azure listing: account prerequisites and technical sprint plan

Sarah — looping in Karthik for the technical handoff. Karthik, can your team allocate 2 engineers for a short sprint next week (1/11-1/13) to provide the ARM templates and create the SP with the requested roles?

Action plan (short MAP):
- Owner: Acme Infra (devops@acmecloud.com) — provide test subscription ID + create SP (Reader + Contributor on test RG) — due Day 0
- Owner: Acme Dev — provide ARM template, sample parameters.json, and smoke-test endpoints — due Day 1
- Owner: Redwood (Tessa + Marissa) — run validation, capture logs, and surface portal errors — due Day 2

Deliverables to upload to the portal during/after the sprint:
- manifest (sample_manifest.json)
- ARM template / provisioning runbook
- tenant-proof.pdf + support contact
- MAP-v1.docx (attached) — contains the timeline and handoff checklist.

If Acme can grant read-only access to the test subscription and add the service principal with Contributor on the test resource group, that will reduce back-and-forth. Proposed kickoff: Tue 1/11 10:00 AM PST (same as Tessa's suggestion) — we can do 30 minutes to align.

Thanks — Marissa
Principal, Publisher Programs, Redwood Inference
(attachment: MAP-v1.docx)
